description: Overwrite a file on a specific instance (by id or exact name) with raw text, creating it if it does not exist. This replaces the entire file, so any content you do not include is lost, including comments. Prefer edit_file for changing part of an existing file. Requires `confirm: true`; show the user the path and the full new contents first.

confirm.description: Must be set to true. Acts as a guard against accidental writes, so always show the user the path and full contents before setting this.

contents.description: The complete new file contents as raw text.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

path.description: File to write, from the instance root, e.g. "/config/server.properties".

name: write_file
title: Write File
